# Soulo

> Soulo is a privacy-first iOS multi-search browser and public product website.

Soulo lets users enter one query and quickly switch between 40+ global platforms, including web search, video, shopping, developer communities, and third-party AI platforms. Soulo does not generate or merge those platforms' answers. The public website is available without authentication and may be indexed or summarized according to `robots.txt`.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://soulo.dkluge.com/): Product overview, supported platform categories, core features, App Store download, and batch import examples for movie and book search sources.
- [Privacy Policy](https://soulo.dkluge.com/privacy.html): Privacy and on-device data handling policy for the app.
- [Full LLM Context](https://soulo.dkluge.com/llms-full.txt): Expanded summary of product facts and privacy commitments.

## Product Facts

- Product name: Soulo
- Chinese name: 搜罗
- Platform: iOS app
- Category: Multi-platform search browser
- Website languages: Chinese and English
- Core features: quick switching between 40+ search and AI platforms, voice search, ad blocking, custom platforms, privacy-first local storage

## Crawling Notes

- The website is public and does not require login.
- Main content is rendered directly in HTML.
- Crawlers should follow [robots.txt](https://soulo.dkluge.com/robots.txt).
- Sitemap is available at [sitemap.xml](https://soulo.dkluge.com/sitemap.xml).
